name: Rajma masala

advance_prep.instruction: Soak rajma overnight in plenty of water, discard soaking water

steps.text: Pressure cook soaked rajma with salt, 8 whistles or 25 minutes.
steps.cue: A bean crushes easily between two fingers with no chalky centre.

steps.text: Fry cumin, onion, ginger and garlic in oil until brown.
steps.cue: The onion is a deep golden brown.

steps.text: Add tomato and spices, cook to a paste.
steps.cue: Onion golden brown at the edges, tomato broken into a thick paste with oil shimmering at the sides.

steps.text: Add rajma with some cooking liquid, simmer 15 minutes, mash a few beans to thicken.
steps.cue: The gravy is thick and coats a spoon, and a few beans have been crushed to thicken it.
steps.tip: Mash a few beans against the side of the pot rather than adding flour.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze in portions for 3 months. It tastes better the next day. Reheat until it bubbles, adding water if it has thickened.
